description:
Scan recent seller orders for cancellation requests. Calls Fulfillment API getOrders and returns orders whose cancelState is not NONE_REQUESTED (or that list cancel requests). Read-only helper — does not use the deprecated Post-Order API.

Required OAuth Scope: sell.fulfillment.readonly or sell.fulfillment
Minimum Scope: https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope/sell.fulfillment.readonly

maxResults.description: Maximum orders to scan via getOrders (default 50)

name: ebay_get_cancellation_requests
